notablePrerequisites:
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Malcolm does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block Malcolm.
description:
Attack with Malcolm.
When Malcolm deals combat damage to an opponent, he triggers creating a Treasure token.
Tap and sacrifice two Treasure tokens, adding 2 mana of any color.
Furnace Celebration triggers twice.
Don't pay for the first trigger.
Pay for the second Furnace Celebration trigger, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat steps 3-7
